defaults.accessibility: The owning control supplies its accessible name. Decorative glyphs are aria-hidden; a standalone meaningful glyph requires a label.
defaults.reducedMotion: Animated glyphs become static when reduced motion is requested.

slots.button.leading: Leading action or state inside a text button.
slots.button.trailing: Trailing direction or destination inside a text button.
slots.button.icon-only: Icon-only button whose control owns an accessible name and minimum hit target.
slots.loading.indicator: Progressive loading indicator with a reduced-motion static state.

control.back.label: Back
control.back.usage: Return to the preceding view or hierarchy level.

control.close.label: Close
control.close.usage: Dismiss a dialog, sheet or transient surface.

control.confirm.label: Confirm
control.confirm.usage: Confirm a selection or completed control state.

control.disclosure.label: Disclose
control.disclosure.usage: Reveal a menu, list or additional content.

control.edit.label: Edit
control.edit.usage: Modify an existing item or value.

control.external.label: Open externally
control.external.usage: Open a destination outside the current application context.

control.filter.label: Filter
control.filter.usage: Filter a collection or data view.

control.loading.label: Loading
control.loading.usage: Indicate progressive work without implying completion.

control.more.label: More actions
control.more.usage: Open an overflow menu of additional actions.

control.refresh.label: Refresh
control.refresh.usage: Refresh or synchronize the current data.

control.remove.label: Remove
control.remove.usage: Remove an item from a collection without implying permanent deletion.

control.run.label: Run
control.run.usage: Start or submit a governed operation.

state.error.label: Error
state.error.usage: An error, blocked state or failed validation.

state.info.label: Information
state.info.usage: Neutral information that requires attention but not intervention.

state.success.label: Success
state.success.usage: A successful, current or completed state.

state.warning.label: Warning
state.warning.usage: A caution, review or escalating risk state.
